definitions.gloss: spirit of adventure; adventurousness; sense of adventure
definitions.explanation: The desire or willingness to take on challenges, try new things, or explore the unknown. Often used positively to describe curiosity and boldness.

examples.japanese: {冒険心|ぼうけんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くすぐられる→くすぐる：07620_kusuguru⟧。
examples.english: It tickles my sense of adventure.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冒険心|ぼうけんしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あふれて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I was full of adventurous spirit.

examples.japanese: {冒険心|ぼうけんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{旺盛|おうせい}→旺盛：09331_ousei⟧な⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧アマゾン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥地|おくち}→奥地：16541_okuchi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Having a strong sense of adventure, he traveled alone deep into the Amazon.

notes:
USAGE:
{冒険心|ぼうけんしん} follows the common Japanese pattern of combining a noun with {心|しん} (heart/spirit) to express a feeling or disposition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冒険心|ぼうけんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くすぐる→くすぐる：07620_kusuguru⟧ (to stimulate one's sense of adventure)
- {冒険心|ぼうけんしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あふれる (to be full of adventurous spirit)
- {冒険心|ぼうけんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{旺盛|おうせい}→旺盛：09331_ousei⟧ (having a strong sense of adventure)

RELATED PATTERN:
Other 〜{心|しん} compounds: ⟦{好奇心|こうきしん}→好奇心：05213_koukishin⟧ (curiosity), ⟦{探究心|たんきゅうしん}→探究心：05793_tankyuushin⟧ (spirit of inquiry), ⟦{向上心|こうじょうしん}→向上心：11897_koujoushin⟧ (desire for self-improvement).
